name: rudra-backend
description: Rudra headless backend platform — reusable backend primitives

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/run-scoped.mjs apps --parallel dev
scripts.test: node scripts/run-scoped.mjs packages test && node scripts/run-scoped.mjs apps test
